description: Covers advanced mathematical signal processing, functional analysis, Fourier and wavelet transforms, compressed sensing, and sparse data representations.
learning_objectives: Understand Hilbert spaces, orthogonal projections, and linear functional analysis.
Apply Fourier, wavelet, and multi-resolution analysis to high-dimensional datasets.
Formulate compressed sensing, sparse representations, and matrix completion problems.
Implement scalable computational algorithms for signal and data recovery.
outline: Mathematical Foundations: Hilbert spaces, inner product spaces, orthogonal projections, linear functional analysis.
Transform Techniques: Fourier series, Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT), Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), wavelets, time-frequency analysis.
Stochastic Signal Processing: Random processes, stationarity, autocorrelation, power spectral density, Wiener and Kalman filtering.
High-Dimensional Analysis: Dimensionality reduction, Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma, Compressed Sensing, sparse recovery algorithms.
Computational Optimization: Large-scale data algorithms, regularized inversion, numerical stability.

books.title: Discrete-Time Signal Processing
books.author: Alan V. Oppenheim, Ronald W. Schafer

books.title: A Wavelet Tour of Signal Processing: The Sparse Way
